title.zh: Ontology forces urgent node upgrade after restarting chain hit by malicious activity
title.en: Ontology forces urgent node upgrade after restarting chain hit by malicious activity

current_state.zh: Ontology resumed its mainnet after a security pause and requires all sync-node operators to urgently upgrade to version 3.1.5 to stay compatible with the restored chain.
